Dear Friends, Family, and Kind Supporters,

My name is Swamling Pujari, and I am reaching out to you with a heavy heart to save my 31-year-old son, Daresh Swamling Pujari.

Daresh has been diagnosed with a severe and aggressive blood condition — Myelodysplastic Syndrome (MDS) / Blood Cancer with high-risk genetic mutations (TP53+). He is currently undergoing critical chemotherapy cycles in Sangli to stabilize his condition, after which he has been urgently advised to undergo a life-saving Allogeneic / Haplo-identical Bone Marrow Transplant (BMT) at Deenanath Mangeshkar Hospital and Research Centre, Pune.

A Bone Marrow Transplant is his only definitive cure and chance at long-term survival.

The estimated cost for the BMT procedure, specialized pre-transplant workup, donor conditioning, and post-transplant ICU isolation care is ₹20,00,000 (Twenty Lakh Rupees).

As a modest working-class family, we have completely exhausted our life savings, taken loans, and stretched all our resources to fund his ongoing chemotherapy, supportive care, and hospital visits.

"Raising ₹20 Lakhs in such a short timeframe is completely beyond our financial capacity."

We urgently need your generous support, kindness, and prayers to help Daresh win this battle. He is young, full of life, and fighting bravely every single day.

How You Can Help

  • 1Contribute: Any donation, big or small, will directly support his life-saving transplant.
  • 2Share: Please amplify our plea by sharing this page across your WhatsApp groups, Facebook, Instagram, and other networks.

Every single rupee and share brings Daresh one step closer to defeating cancer. We will forever remain grateful for your compassion.

Thank you from the bottom of our hearts.
